node.statement: From C_ch*(epsilon_r + delta) <= kappa_ch, C_ch >= Cbar, 0 < kappa_ch <= kappabar, and epsilon_r + delta >= 0, one has Cbar*(epsilon_r + delta) <= C_ch*(epsilon_r + delta) <= kappa_ch <= kappabar, which is precisely the smallness guard of lem-stage1-maurer-cartan-trivialization.
